name: @fahrizkyputra/pi-auto-resume
description: Resume a Pi session automatically after a rate limit: reads the reset hint, waits, then sends a marked continuation. Also waits out 5-hour and weekly plan windows by their real end time, and retries dropped streams and timeless failures on a backoff.
